deployments_detail.use: "Citi Assist" + "Citi Stylus" GenAI/agentic tools rolled out to ~140,000 employees across 8 countries

Citi Stylus Workspaces — proprietary agentic-AI platform that executes complex multi-stage workflows across internal systems, data, project tools, employee directory and web search from a single prompt.
deployments_detail.value: thousands of employees in early access from Sept 2025

deployments_detail.use: AI in the Markets division to process documents and create capacity for oversight/control functions.
deployments_detail.value: 4,400+ documents processed monthly; 1,700+ hours of monthly oversight capacity

deployments_detail.use: Arc — internal platform letting Citi developers build and deploy AI agents on top models within a unified, secure infrastructure, for defined business/function use cases.
AI coding and automated code review for software engineers, including agentic AI — used to review code, generate developer capacity, and accelerate legacy application migrations.
deployments_detail.value: 10,000+ engineers; 1.5M+ automated code reviews; ~100,000 developer hours/week; app migration cut from ~12 months to 4 weeks
